or 170-280 (250-350) |id = 11176 }} '''[[Araxyte]]s''' are a potential slayer assignment from [[Nieve]]/[[Steve]], [[Duradel]]/[[Kuradal]], and [[Mortimer]], after completion of [[Priest in Peril]]. [[Turael]]/[[Aya]] and [[Spria]] can also assign them, albeit indirectly as a '''[[spider|spiders]]''' task. They require 92 [[Slayer]] in order to be harmed and are found exclusively in the [[Morytania Spider Cave]]. Araxytes attack with [[melee]], and are also able to inflict [[venom]] starting at 6 damage, therefore, it is recommended to bring [[Venom#Curing venom|venom immunity]] to all encounters, preferably [[extended anti-venom+]] for long trips. They are fairly far from a bank, though a [[spider cave teleport]] will bring players to the entrance of the cave. ==Normal Araxytes== {{Inventory|align=right |1= Extended anti-venom+(4) |2= Super restore(4) |3= Super restore(4) |4= Super restore(4) |5= Extended anti-venom+(4) |6= Super restore(4) |7= Super restore(4) |8= Super restore(4) |9= Cooked karambwan |10= Cooked karambwan |11= Bracelet of slaughter |12= Bracelet of slaughter |26= Seed box |27= Herb sack |28= Rune pouch }} {{Rune pouch|align=right |1=Nature rune |2=Fire rune }} When completing a task of normal araxytes, it is highly recommended the player avoids killing any level 96 araxytes; their drop table is worse than the level 146 variant and they are notably unable to spawn their superior, the [[Dreadborn Araxyte|dreadborn araxyte]]. Only the level 146 variants will spawn them, so entire tasks of normal araxytes should be done with the stronger ones. While they are mixed in the main chamber, there are three on-task caves east from it, the northern cave is a single-way zone with level 146 araxytes, while the eastern and southern caves are multi-way zones with level 96 and 146 variants respectively. A task of normal araxytes is very profitable, as they have many stackable and/or alchemy drops. Both a [[seed box]] and [[herb sack]] are highly recommended. Even with a cannon, players will generally profit off the task, especially when picking up [[Araxyte venom sac]]s. At high kill rates such as when using a cannon players may find it useful to set the araxytes attack option to right click due to the high speed of venom sac and double loot drops to reduce click intensity. A [[dwarf multicannon]] can also be used throughout the cave, and can kill araxytes very quickly in multicombat areas. This should ideally be combined with a [[venator bow]], due to the larger araxytes' 2x2 hitboxes making barrages harder to utilise. However, by running diagonally through an araxyte repeatedly, it is possible to stack them for barraging. [[Bracelet of slaughter|Bracelets of slaughter]] can be used to extend the task. ==Araxyte Boss== {{Main|Araxxor}} Alternatively, the player can kill [[Araxxor]] as part of an araxyte task, which is more profitable at the cost of being much slower. Players can also boost from level 87 Slayer to kill Araxxor with a [[Slayer task/Spiders|spiders task]], but the boost must be maintained for the entire kill. The [[Araxxor/Strategies#Equipment|recommended inventory and equipment]] differs from a task of normal araxytes, notably it is highly recommended that players have a strong crush weapon before attempting to kill Araxxor. ==Slayer Unlocks== {{Main|Slayer Rewards}} {|class="wikitable sortable lighttable align-center-1 align-center-3" ! colspan="2" | Unlock !
